name: Rescue from the Deep

start.dialog: My partner! Tunneler Purple! Cave collapsed on him in the deep mines! I hear him tapping! But can't reach! Too dangerous! You strong! You help?
start.objective: Navigate the collapsed mines and rescue Tunneler Purple

progress.dialog: Still hear tapping! Morse code! He says... 'hurry' and 'hungry'! Please!
progress.objective: Clear rubble and defeat cave creatures to reach the trapped tunneler

complete.dialog: You saved him! My partner! My friend! Here - rare Prism diamonds! Best quality! From our secret vein! You family now!

party_comments.kade: Never leave a partner behind. Good motto.
party_comments.grit: Mining accidents are serious. Glad we could help.

hidden_outcome: If you rescue Purple within 5 minutes (speed run), you gain access to the 'Secret Diamond Vein' - unlimited rare gem mining spot
